artifacts.summary: Confirms no existing isolation-forwarding prohibition in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md Move 2, enumerates every dispatch-row field's actual use, and recommends three source-store edits: a categorical MUST NOT in SKILL.md Move 2, a strengthened isolation/worktree_path header note in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, and an optional cross-link from batch-orchestration-guardrails.md's Deliberate Divergences bullet.

memory_candidates.content: The orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh dispatch[] row schema carries an `isolation` field ("none"/"worktree") that is purely descriptive dispatch-site wiring, never consumed by skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's Move 2 Agent-tool call. This collides dangerously with the harness Agent tool's own real `isolation` parameter (enum "worktree"/"remote"): a dispatch row's isolation:"worktree" value is a syntactically valid value for that argument, so accidental forwarding produces no schema error, only a stacked second worktree checkout that the harness then refuses to git-commit across. When reviewing any dispatch-row-to-tool-call wiring, check field names against the target tool's own parameter names, not just against local schema consistency.
